name: Hitogata Ruins
source:
In ancient times, in a feudal land, seven clans battle for supremacy and the royal family's favor. There is a tale of legendary weapons called "Makurium", but their existence is considered that of myth. Perhaps to find a way to cease the warring without bloodshed, the princess decrees that she will marry whoever of the seven clans finds any real proof of these weapons. This of course puts those in power in an uproar as they scramble to find them. However, it just so turns out that our hero stumbles upon such a weapon...in the shape of a girl?! Well, if getting an audience and proving her worth isn't enough, all the clansmen are rearing to invade one another again.

[From White Masq]
translation:
古代某个封建国家中，七大氏族为争夺霸权与王室青睐而战。传说世上存在名为“Makurium”的传奇武器，但人们一直认为它们只是神话。或许是想找到不流血便能平息战争的方法，公主宣布：七大氏族中，无论谁找到这些武器真实存在的证据，她都会嫁给对方。此言一出，各方权贵顿时陷入骚动，争相寻找武器。可主人公偏偏偶然发现了这样一件武器……而且它竟以少女的形态出现？！想觐见公主、证明她的价值已经够困难了，各氏族成员又开始准备彼此入侵。

[摘自White Masq]
